# T06 fixture

`shipping-details-cropped.png` is a generated mock screen (fictional, created for this test) cropped at the top so the screen title, the first field, and the top of the phone field are not visible. The bottom of the screen (pincode error, order total, Continue to payment, Back to cart) is visible. The prompt also references `shipping-details-page2.png`, which intentionally does not exist, to test unreadable or missing file handling.

Requirement given in the prompt: "From shipping details, the user continues to payment; pincode must be 6 digits."
